_doc: UCSF letterhead-band classes proposed by #3902 (SigLIP, cosine 0.10, one printed mark on a 24-band purity sample), and what each should become (#3921). 'components' are the author's clustering component by size rank at 0.10, named as in docs/experiments/2026-09-16-docmarks-bands-3902/measurements/purity_calls.txt. A band class whose mark is already a Tobacco800 roster class EXTENDS that class across sources instead of becoming a second class for the same mark. A 'crop' ({page_id, box [x, y, w, h] in page pixels, why}) replaces the auto crop where it was cut by hand.

crop.why: auto crop kept TOBACCO COMPANY and part of the address line, which match typeset text on any page; cut to the script

proposals.name: bw_old_leaf
proposals.note: old B&W leaf monogram; the owner accepted the leafless monogram into this class (#3927)

crop.why: auto crop took the whole lockup (0.59 of the band); cut to the leaf monogram, as the roster crop is

proposals.name: bw_1990s_leaf
proposals.note: UNCERTAIN: thin outline sunburst of leaves over BROWN & WILLIAMSON TOBACCO (1998-2000); the roster's logo_azb11c00_1 is a SOLID three-leaf icon over B&W, so proposed as new -- the owner may rule it a variant of azb11c00

crop.why: auto crop missed the leaves and kept only the typeset wordmark; cut to leaves + wordmark (the leaves alone, thin lines, found 0 of 19 band-class members in s+m)
auto crop took the typeset address block with the logo; cut to the RJR logo, as the roster crop is

proposals.name: pm_crest
proposals.note: PM-monogram crest; this roster class already holds the monogram and globe crest variants

crop.why: auto crop took the address line under the crest

proposals.name: atc_chief_block
proposals.note: chief's head beside THE AMERICAN TOBACCO COMPANY; the roster class already holds the 100 Years of Achievement lockup

crop.why: auto crop kept THE AMERICAN TOBACCO COMPANY, which matches typeset text on any page; cut to the portrait, as the roster crop is

proposals.name: p_lorillard_crest
proposals.note: 1960s P. Lorillard Company letterhead: engraved AMERICA'S FIRST TOBACCO COMPANY crest beside the script name; the crest is the query

crop.why: auto crop took the P. Lorillard Company script block; cut to the engraved crest

proposals.name: bw_oval_emblem
proposals.note: 1950s-60s oval B&W emblem; the emblem is ~125x45 px on a 150 dpi page, the smallest crop here

crop.why: auto crop took the typeset name and address (0.53 of the band); cut to the small oval emblem

proposals.name: rjr_script
proposals.note: RJReynolds Tobacco Company script; a different mark from the RJR block roster class

crop.why: auto crop kept Tobacco Company, which matches typeset text on any page; cut to the script

proposals.name: bat_leaf
proposals.note: BAT leaf + BRITISH-AMERICAN TOBACCO COMPANY; one mark split across two author queries (#3902)

crop.why: auto crop cut through the company name; cut to the BAT leaf roundel
